data.description:
## Summary

The Gerrit Verified Gate's macOS `pytest (macos-latest, py3.13)` cell fails fast
(~1m30s) with **pytest exit code 5 ("no tests ran")** for any in-flight change whose
patchset tree **predates the `platform_compat` auto-marker** landed by story
omphacite-desertlike-coney. All three Ubuntu cells pass; only macOS fails, blocking
`Verified +1` for otherwise-correct changes. Reproduced on runs 32927544184,
32927483100, 32927478228 (all testing `refs/changes/26/2226/*`, base `01ef008e`).

## Proven root cause (regression)

The macOS default-suite step selects `-m "platform_compat and not external"` via
`DEFAULT_SUITE_MARKS`. The `platform_compat` marker is applied **only** at collection
time by `tests/conftest.py::pytest_collection_modifyitems` (path-fragment auto-marker).
The Verified gate runs `_build-and-test.yml` from **trusted main** (reusable-workflow
ref binding) against the **raw patchset tree**. A patchset whose base predates the
auto-marker has **zero** tests carrying `platform_compat`, so the selection matches
nothing → pytest exits 5 → the job fails.

Discriminating experiment (runtime oracle):

| tree state | collected | exit |
|---|---|---|
| current main (auto-marker present) | 909 | 0 |
| auto-marker neutralized (= pre-marker patchset tree) | 0 | 5 |

Restoring the marker → rc 0; removing it → rc 5. This isolates the conftest
auto-marker as the necessary cause and rules out strict-markers (which errors as
"unknown mark"), the invocation, and the integration tier.

## Defect origin

`caused_by` story omphacite-desertlike-coney (`3ba8-49d5-fee5-445d`, commit
`920492b1`), class **regression**. That change split the contract across two halves —
the workflow selection (`platform_compat`) and the conftest marker application — and
the trusted-main workflow half applies to patchset trees that lack the conftest half.
Before it, macOS ran the full suite and never spuriously exited 5. It escaped its own
gate because A's gate run executed the pre-A full macOS suite (the reduction only takes
effect after merge, by the same ref-binding).

## Approach

Make the macOS default-suite step **tolerate an empty `platform_compat` collection**:
capture pytest's exit code and, **only on `macos-latest`**, map rc 5 → success. This
restores the pre-regression behaviour (the gate does not spuriously fail on a
pre-marker tree) while keeping A's speedup for current trees. It is safe because:

- Every patchset is still **fully exercised on the Ubuntu cells** (whole-suite
  selection, which does not depend on the marker).
- A **current-tree** marker regression is still caught on Ubuntu by
  `test_platform_compat_suite_covers_the_core_os_sensitive_seams`.
- On every **other** cell the selection is the whole suite, where rc 5 remains a real
  empty-suite failure that must stay red — the tolerance is macOS-only.

## Scope boundary

Changes only the macOS branch's exit-code handling in `_build-and-test.yml`'s
default-suite step, plus a behavioural parity guard. No matrix, runner, fixture, or
Python-version change. Does not touch the `external`-marker lanes (non-gate, scheduled,
run on their own tree, path-pinned — no tree skew).

## Testing

New behavioural guard `test_macos_default_suite_lane_passes_when_platform_compat_collects_nothing`
renders the step's GitHub expressions per cell, stubs `pytest` to exit 5, executes the
real lane shell, and asserts **macOS → pass (0)** while **every Ubuntu cell → fail (5)**.
Seen RED first (macOS returns 5) on the unfixed workflow; GREEN after the fix.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The macOS default-suite lane treats pytest exit 5 (no `platform_compat` tests
      collected) as success, so a patchset whose tree predates the auto-marker gets a
      green macOS cell.
- [ ] The Ubuntu cells still fail on an empty collection (rc 5 remains a real failure
      off the macOS cell).
- [ ] A behavioural test executes the lane's real shell and asserts macOS→0 /
      ubuntu→5, verified RED before the fix.
- [ ] `make lint` and the full `test_ci_workflow_parity.py` suite pass.
data.title: Verified gate macOS cell fails (pytest exit 5) for patchsets predating the platform_compat auto-marker
